task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Unify command of the epidemic response, issue directives to affected commanderies, and coordinate all other offices' efforts.
Release treasury funds and state grain reserves to procure medicine and food, sustain quarantined populations, and grant tax relief to stricken cities.
Mobilize imperial physicians and medical knowledge for treatment and containment, and direct workshops to produce medical supplies and quarantine facilities.
Dispatch inspectors to stricken cities to verify relief delivery, monitor official conduct, and prevent hoarding or embezzlement.
